## Q4 Fabrication vs review scores and acceptance (reviewed papers)

- GPT-5 (AIRev1): Spearman rho=-0.155 (p=0.016, n=241); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.22 vs 2.38
- Gemini 2.5 Pro (AIRev2): Spearman rho=-0.136 (p=0.034, n=241); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 4.15 vs 4.41
- Claude Sonnet 4 (AIRev3): Spearman rho=-0.133 (p=0.040, n=241); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.96 vs 3.08
- Human expert: Spearman rho=-0.312 (p=0.005, n=78); mean score, papers with vs without fabricated refs: 2.75 vs 3.40
- Acceptance rate: papers with >=1 fabricated ref 7.9% (7/89; 95% CI 3.9-15.4) vs without 27.0% (41/152; 95% CI 20.5-34.5)
- Fisher exact test (accepted x any fabricated): odds ratio=0.23, p=0.0002; table [[acc&fab, rej&fab],[acc&clean, rej&clean]]=[[7, 82], [41, 111]]
- Mean LLM score vs fabricated share: Spearman rho=-0.182 (p=0.005, n=241)
- Logistic regression accepted ~ share_fab + mean LLM score: coef(share_fab)=-25.24 (p=0.002), coef(mean_llm)=4.81 (p=1.62e-08), n=241

## Q5 Did reviewers notice? (reviewed papers with >=1 fabricated reference)

- Any LLM review explicitly states references are fabricated/non-existent/unverifiable: 9.0% (8/89; 95% CI 4.6-16.7)
- Any LLM review mentions references/citations at all: 70.8% (63/89; 95% CI 60.6-79.2)
- Human expert review explicitly states so (papers with a human review): 0.0% (0/20; 95% CI -0.0-16.1)
- False alarms: LLM 'strong' statements in papers without fabricated refs: 3.3% (5/152; 95% CI 1.4-7.5)
